comment: The PS2 build's inputs (tools/ps2_build.py). The game's files and flags are the Linux build's (port/linux/port.json); these are what the PS2 build adds and leaves out.

port_game_units.comment: The port's game units (port/linux/game) the PS2 build leaves out; the game's calls to them are stubbed until the PS2 has them.

linux_platform_sources.comment: The Linux platform layer's files (port/linux/src) that the PS2 build compiles as they are.
